NAVY canvas/leather shoulder loops on opposite CONTACT side. Soft AIRSHIP technology silhouette. The bladder+hoops+vane all ROTATE TOGETHER on one bearing; bladder must be securely attached to rotor hoop cradle, never floating and no supports to case except central bearing. No propeller wings. Top rotor modest about60% casewidth.MANDATORY ANIMATABLE TOP: visibly articulated and DISTINCT top mechanical assembly supported ONLY by ONE clear central spindle/swivel BEARING root on the case. A real circular bearing collar and small gap/clearance between rotating rotor assembly and fixed case are visible. The WHOLE top including all antenna/frame/fabric sections above bearing can rotate freely as a rigid assembly when hero jumps. All top parts connected firmly to each other ABOVE that one bearing. NO diagonal brace, fixed cable, second support or rigid rod from top back to case or harness. Clear full rotation clearance around top, no motion blur or action arrows. This is a design reference for later separate 3D rigging, not actual animation.Generate ONLY BACK orthographic view: the DECORATED OUTWARD SPEAKER FACE facing camera, NOT contact harness side. BACK is primary modeling reference. Shoulder straps attach on far reverse side and may peek around outer sides, but do not cover speakers. Level camera, zero yaw/pitch. No wearer. Preserve sensible durable connections and coherent material/part geometry. Attached classic backpack is MATERIAL/RENDERING STYLE ONLY. Create the NEW variant geometry described, do not copy the classic rectangular housing/antenna. Distinct second option for same character.
